prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a side impact at intersection claim. Injury: shoulder injury. The claimant is represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1145; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Claim received for a side impact collision at a signalized intersection. Insured vehicle was struck on the driver side by a vehicle that entered on a red signal. Claimant reports right shoulder pain at the scene and was transported to the emergency department. Police report requested and pending.

Entry 2: Claimant is now represented by counsel. All further contact to be routed through the attorney's office. Letter of representation on file. Requested itemized medical records and treatment history through counsel.

Entry 3: Reviewed scene photographs and vehicle damage estimates. Damage consistent with a broadside impact to the rear driver door and quarter panel. Intersection camera footage requested from municipality; response pending. Liability currently appears to favor our insured but remains under review.

Entry 4: Spoke with claimant's attorney regarding the shoulder injury. Counsel reports ongoing physical therapy and a possible rotator cuff tear pending MRI results. Requested updated medical status and expected treatment timeline. Attorney indicated a demand package will follow once treatment is complete.

Entry 5: Received updated medical documentation from claimant's counsel. Records reflect orthopedic consultation and continued treatment for shoulder injury. Reserve reviewed and adjusted to reflect current medical information. Claim remains open pending receipt of demand, police report, and municipal footage.
